notes.subject: להתרעע
notes.rationale: KJV reads 'must show himself friendly' from a similar root; ASV/JPS read 'to his own destruction/ruin' — the Hebrew hitpael of רעע points to being broken

notes.subject: רעים / להתרעע
notes.rationale: Same root רע in 'friends' and 'come to ruin' — companions and calamity sound alike, lost in Bambara

notes.subject: Mɔgɔ min bɛ kɛɲɛ-mɔgɔw caman sɔrɔ, a bɛ se ka bɔn
notes.rationale: Follows the ruin reading: many companions bring one to ruin

translation: Mɔgɔ min bɛ kɛɲɛ-mɔgɔw caman sɔrɔ, a bɛ se ka bɔn; nka kanubaga dɔ bɛ yen min bɛ mara ka surun balimakɛ la ta sɔrɔ.
